text: Four ghost stories drawn from old Japan. A poor swordsman in Kyoto [abandons his devoted wife to marry into wealth|wrong|love betrayed], then comes home years later to [a tender welcome from the woman he left|archetypes|The Woman Who Comes Back] that does not last until morning. A young woodcutter sheltering in a boatman's hut watches a snow spirit kill his old mentor and is spared, [on condition he never speaks of that night|rules|break the rule and pay]. Years later, by candlelight, he tells the story to Yuki, his ageless wife, and [a snowstorm gathers over the house|images|weather, sky and darkness].
